name: Karpathy builds HackerTube with Claude Opus 5.5 in about two hours
title: Karpathy builds HackerTube with Claude Opus 5.5 in about two hours
summary: Karpathy built hackertube.org, a YouTube-style site of 6,454 videos recommended in about 40K Hacker News comments since 2007 across 150 topics, in roughly two hours with Opus 5.5 on medium effort. By his count over 90% of tokens went to Sonnet labeling comments, and the app plus deploy took about 1M Opus tokens. Launched Oct 31 and missed by earlier sweeps; caught via recaps (no repo linked).
